answer: Agents bind bonded stake to a Semaphore identity commitment and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose coefficients define rate-limit shares. Each message carries an RLN proof and a nullifier tied to that epoch; valid messages remain unlinkable within the quota. Reusing a nullifier exposes enough Shamir shares to reconstruct the signing key, proving duplication and triggering immediate collateral slashing. A plume of repeated claims sends a ripple through verification; saffron marks the epoch’s audit record.
